description_en: Creates an integration pipeline or unstructured workflow node
description_zh: 创建集成管道/非结构化工作流任务
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-pipeline --op-tenant-id 30001011 --context ProjectId=123 Env=DEV --create-command '{"ScheduleConfig":"cronExpression_:_0_0_0_0_0_0","Comment":"comment","PipelineConfig":{},"NodeInfo":{},"PipelineType":0,"Mode":"PIPELINE","Submit":true,"PipelineJson":"example-string","Settings":"example-string"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipeline

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operator user
parameters.name: op_user_id

fields.help_en:
The current operating environment. Valid values:

DEV: the development environment.
PROD: the production environment.

For workflow nodes, only PROD is supported
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境（对于工作流，目前仅支持PROD）
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: The ID of the project to which the integration pipeline or workflow node belongs
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流任务所属项目ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en: The comment
fields.help_zh: 备注
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en:
The integration pipeline configuration mode. Valid values:

PIPELINE: pipeline mode. This is the default value.
JSON: script mode.

If the node is a workflow node, you can ignore this parameter
fields.help_zh:
集成管道配置模式：PIPELINE-表示管道模式（默认），JSON-表示脚本模式。
如果为工作流，则无需关注
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The folder of the integration pipeline or workflow node. Default value: root folder. The folder must already exist. If it does not exist, call the relevant API operation to create a folder of type offlinePipeline (or unstructuredPipeline for workflows)
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流任务节点目录（默认为根目录），该目录必须存在，如若不存在，则需要调用相关接口创建类型为offlinePipeline（工作流则为unstructuredPipeline）的目录
fields.name: directory

fields.help_en: The pipeline or workflow file ID. Leave this parameter empty for initial creation. When updating a pipeline or workflow node, specify at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId
fields.help_zh: 管道/工作流 文件ID，首次创建为空，更新管道/工作流 任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: The scheduling node ID of the pipeline or workflow node. Leave this parameter empty for initial creation. When updating a pipeline or workflow node, specify at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId
fields.help_zh: 管道/工作流 任务调度节点ID，首次创建为空，更新管道/工作流 任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en: The name of the integration pipeline or workflow node
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流 任务名称
fields.name: node_name

fields.help_en: The pipeline or workflow node ID. Leave this parameter empty for initial creation. When updating a pipeline or workflow node, specify at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId
fields.help_zh: 管道/工作流 任务ID，首次创建为空，更新管道/工作流任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: The basic information of the integration pipeline or workflow node
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流 任务基本信息
fields.name: node_info

fields.help_en: Specifies the downstream condition for a conditional distribution component. Set this parameter to true if the downstream condition is true, or false otherwise. If the node is a workflow node, you can ignore this parameter
fields.help_zh:
针对条件分发组件，连接下游条件为true时设置为true，否则设置为false。
如果为工作流任务，则无需关注
fields.name: send_to

fields.help_en: The name of the input step, which corresponds to Steps[*].StepName
fields.help_zh: 输入步骤名称，即Steps[*].StepName
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The name of the output step, which corresponds to Steps[*].StepName
fields.help_zh: 输出步骤名称，即Steps[*].StepName
fields.name: target

fields.help_en: The directed acyclic graph (DAG) link configuration that describes the connections between all components or operators
fields.help_zh: DAG有向无环图链接配置：描述所有组件/算子的连接关系
fields.name: hops

fields.help_en:
Specifies the data distribution mode when the current component has multiple downstream components. Valid values:

true: The data of the current component is distributed to all downstream components in a round-robin manner. For example, if the current component has 100 records and two downstream components, each downstream component receives 50 records. Default value: true.
false: The full data of the current component is sent to all downstream components. For example, if the current component has 100 records and two downstream components, both downstream components receive 100 records.

If the node is a workflow node, you can ignore this parameter
fields.help_zh:
用于表示当前组件有多个下游组件时当前组件数据的分发方式：
true-表示当前组件的数据轮流发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有100条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游各有50条数据，默认为true，
false-表示当前组件的数据全量发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有100条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游都有100条数据。
如果为工作流任务，则无需关注此值
fields.name: is_distribute

fields.help_en: The plugin ID. Each plugin or operator has a unique identifier. Refer to the utility class com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey. Developers should inherit the component or operator configuration class and implement the corresponding component or operator configuration. Each component or operator configuration has the same structure as the configuration created on the Dataphin console
fields.help_zh: 插件ID，每个插件/算子都有唯一的标志，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与Dataphin页面创建的配置结构相同
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The specific component configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the toJsonString method of the relevant subclasses of the utility class com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig (for workflow operators, use com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig). Developers should inherit the component or operator configuration class and implement the corresponding component or operator configuration. Each component or operator configuration has the same structure as the node configuration created on the Dataphin console
fields.help_zh: 具体组件配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig（工作流算子则为com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig）相关子类的toJsonString方法。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与Dataphin页面创建的任务配置结构相同
fields.name: plugin_config

fields.help_en: The step name. Step names must be unique within the same pipeline node
fields.help_zh: 步骤名称，在同一个管道任务所有步骤名称不能重复
fields.name: step_name

fields.help_en:
The component type. Valid values:

input: an input component.
output: an output component.
transfrom: a transform component.
process: a flow control component.

For workflow nodes, this parameter specifies the operator type, such as image or text. Refer to the utility class com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType. Developers should inherit the component or operator configuration class and implement the corresponding component or operator configuration. Each component or operator configuration has the same structure as the configuration created on the Dataphin console
fields.help_zh: 组件类型：input-表示输入组件，output-表示输出组件，transfrom-表示转换组件，process-表示流程控制组件，对于工作流任务则表示算子类型，例如：image-图片，text-文本。参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与Dataphin页面创建的配置结构相同
fields.name: step_type

fields.help_en: The component or operator configurations, which contain the detailed configurations of all components or operators used
fields.help_zh: 组件/算子配置：包含所有用到的组件/算子详细配置
fields.name: steps

fields.help_en: The integration pipeline component or workflow operator configuration
fields.help_zh: 集成管道组件/工作流算子配置
fields.name: pipeline_config

fields.help_en: The integration pipeline configuration in JSON string format for script mode. Workflow nodes do not support script mode
fields.help_zh:
脚本模式下：集成管道配置（json字符串格式）。
工作流任务不支持脚本模式
fields.name: pipeline_json

fields.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:

0: offline integration. Default value: 0.
1: real-time integration.
14: offline workflow node.
15: real-time workflow
fields.help_zh: 任务类型：0-表示离线集成（默认），1-表示实时集成，14-表示离线工作流任务，15-表示实时工作流
fields.name: pipeline_type

fields.help_en: The scheduling configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString method
fields.help_zh: 调度配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString方法
fields.name: schedule_config

fields.help_en: The channel configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString method
fields.help_zh: 通道配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString方法
fields.name: settings

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to submit the node. The node is submitted by default
fields.help_zh: 是否提交，默认提交
fields.name: submit

Data.description_zh: 集成管道/工作流 任务创建结果

HostMachine.title_zh: 服务端执行机器名称和ip

PipelineId.description_zh: 创建成功后的管道/工作流 ID

The submit ID of the pending publish list generated after the pipeline is submitted. Use this ID to publish through the publish domain.
Workflow tasks support only PROD, so this value is not returned for workflow tasks
SubmitId.description_zh:
提交管道成功后生成的待发布列表提交ID，通过发布域进行发布。
工作流任务仅支持PROD，因此无此值
SubmitId.title_en: 提交管道生成的待发布列表的submitId，通过发布域进行发布
SubmitId.title_zh: 提交管道生成的待发布列表的submitId，通过发布域进行发布

Version.description_en:
The pending publish version number generated after the pipeline is submitted.

Version.description_zh:
管道提交后生成的待发布版本号。
工作流任务仅支持PROD，因此无此值
